description: Show ONE product's eBay shipping policy. Per eBay site: assignedPolicyId (the product's own choice, null when it has none), defaultPolicyId (the connection default) and effectivePolicyId with effectiveSource — product, connection_default or first_available — the policy a new draft or a go-live would carry, plus that site's policies. For a product with a draft or live listing it also reads the eBay offer live: offer.fulfillmentPolicyId is what buyers see now. Reads only. Use list_ebay_fulfillment_policies for the costs of every policy and get_ebay_offer_policies to read several products' offers at once.

productId.description: A product id returned by search_products.
